# Learning Quadrupedal Locomotion over Challenging Terrain

**Authors:** Jemin Hwangbo, Joonho Lee, Alexey Dosovitskiy, Dario Bellicoso, Vassilios Tsounis, Vijay Koltun, Marco Hutter  
**Year:** 2019  
**Journal:** Science Robotics  
**DOI:** [10.1126/scirobotics.aaw5875](https://doi.org/10.1126/scirobotics.aaw5875)

## Abstract

We present a quadrupedal locomotion system that learns to traverse challenging terrain.
